Chill and Charge

A relaxed space to power up your phone — and yourself — between sets.

← All vendors
What they do

About Chill and Charge

Chill and Charge is a laid-back space where, while you wait for your technology to charge, you can chill, chat, network or just be you.

Once your technology is charged, you too will be recharged, rejuvenated and ready to party on. Charging available by the half hour.
